integrity: Proof relies on independently checked published automata and a new exact sixteen-state transfer calculation. Finite verifier output is corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
limitations: The theorem treats simultaneous single-position letter frequencies and a sharp power exponent; it does not assert higher-block independence, an exact best constant, or a determined oscillation limsup value.
title: Sharp square-root joint discrepancy for two meta-automatic sequences
